_compatNote: Firefox runs background/index.js as an MV3 event page (non-persistent scripts entry; modules unsupported, so the entry ships as a classic script). scripting.executeScript/insertCSS inject content/modal.js + content/modal.css on the clicked tab under the activeTab grant, same as Chromium.
